# Glossary

Rule

Single chaos instruction.

Scenario

Collection of rules.

Mutation

Modification of response payload.

Adapter

Component integrating with browser APIs.

Detector

System finding failures.

Chaos

Intentional degradation.

Failure Injection

Controlled generation of faults.

Recorder

Local capture of selected-tab network observations and journey events.

Error Monitoring

Local collection of console, network, runtime, and unhandled Promise issues. It is not yet a correlation
engine or report generator.

Matcher

The URL, method, resource-type, or GraphQL conditions used to select a request.

Selected Tab

The one browser tab currently owned by the debugger-backed session.

Scenario Activation

Applying one scenario's rules to the selected tab until it is deactivated or replaced.
